_readme: Real DraftKings contest results read from screenshots the owner supplied (standings, FINAL). Scores are 9-slot Classic lineups (DST included). 'rows' are the visible (rank, score, payout) lines; the last visible paid row is the lowest score seen to cash. The screenshots carry no date or slate: they are assumed to be the Week 9 (2026-11-08) Sunday main slate, which the app's own Week 9 results are compared against. Use these to calibrate the cash line; one slate is one data point, and the line moves week to week.
